name: compass
tagline_zh: 代码库像迷宫？用图导航，依赖、调用、影响一目了然。还能查PR风险、历史改动，甚至用CompassQL问问题——别的。
tagline_en: Lost in code? Navigate with graphs—deps, calls, impact. Review PR risks, diffs, ask CompassQL. No other tool does.
desc_en: Use for graph-first codebase navigation and repository analysis: architecture maps, dependency or call-graph tracing, symbol and repository search, pull-request risk review, change-impact review, historical diffs, CompassQL, graph refreshes, exports, MCP serving, or project artifacts. Also use when the user invokes /compass or asks about Compass.
why_zh: 它把代码库变成活地图，用图查询语言直接问架构，而非靠静态索引或猜。
why_en: Turns your codebase into a live graph, queryable via CompassQL—not just static index, but real architectural answers.
